conclusions.a_setWindowFields: Observed on documentdb-local (buildInfo version 7.0.0): two chained $setWindowFields stages, each with a cumulative documents ['unbounded','current'] window ($sum, then $max), followed by $group with $last, ran and returned values equal to a client-side computation, with and without an explicit $sort before $group (a.1, a.2). A single stage with both $sum and $max cumulative windows also matched (a.3). A documents window without sortBy is rejected with code 5339901 Location5339901 'Missing sortBy field for document-based window' (a.4); a range window without sortBy with code 5339902 Location5339902 'Expected a single sort by field for range-based window' (a.7); ['unbounded','unbounded'] without sortBy and no-window/no-sortBy outputs are accepted (a.5, a.6). Explain of the pipeline lists the window stages as '$sort' entries in the stages array (c.6).
conclusions.b_allowDiskUse: aggregate with a full in-memory $sort of 200k docs on an unindexed field succeeded with allowDiskUse true (362 ms) and false (339 ms) with identical results; find.allow_disk_use(True) also accepted. A non-boolean allowDiskUse is rejected with code 14 TypeMismatch, so the field is type-validated even though its value has no observable effect here.
conclusions.c_explain: Top-level find explain: keys command, executionStats, explainCommandExecTimeMillis, explainCommandPlanningTimeMillis, explainVersion (2), ok, queryPlanner; winningPlan at queryPlanner.winningPlan. Aggregate explain: keys command, explainCommandExecTimeMillis, explainCommandPlanningTimeMillis, explainVersion, ok, stages; each stages[i] has one key ($cursor, $sort, $limit, $project, $group) holding its own queryPlanner.winningPlan and executionStats, so the plan lives at stages[0].$cursor.queryPlanner.winningPlan. Stage names seen: FETCH, IXSCAN, SORT, LIMIT, PROJECT, PROJECTION_DEFAULT, GROUP, GROUPSORT, COLLSCAN. An unindexed predicate on the 200k collection did NOT produce COLLSCAN: it produced FETCH (runtimeFilterSet) over IXSCAN indexName '_id_' isBitmap true, totalDocsExamined 200000, totalKeysExamined 215 (c.1). COLLSCAN appeared only inside the $setWindowFields ('$sort') sub-plans on the 24-doc collection (c.6). The vector pipeline explain (c.5d/c.5e) has the same stages[] layout: stages[0].$cursor winningPlan FETCH with cosmosSearchCustomParams {nProbes: 2} over IXSCAN indexName 'vec_ivf', direction Forward, hasOrderBy true, then $limit and $project stages; no SORT and no COLLSCAN stage. A K32-style recursive walk for 'stage' keys finds these names; a COLLSCAN-only check would miss the _id_ IXSCAN full scan on this engine.
conclusions.d_maxTimeMS: aggregate and count_documents with maxTimeMS 1 over 200k docs failed with code 50, codeName 'ExceededTimeLimit', errmsg 'Query exceeded command timeout of 1ms', no errorLabels (pymongo raises ExecutionTimeout). Code 50 is MongoDB's MaxTimeMSExpired, but the codeName string differs from MongoDB's (MongoDB uses ExceededTimeLimit for code 262). find with maxTimeMS 1 did NOT fail: cursor iteration returned all 68160 matches in about 190 ms (d.1), and the raw find returned its first batch in 2 ms (d.2); the remainder was fetched by getMore, which pymongo sends without maxTimeMS, so on this engine the limit was not carried across the cursor. Steps d.6-d.9 (predicates that force the full scan inside the find command) were written but not executed because of the disk incident.
conclusions.scope: All of the above is evidence about the open-source engine and gateway in documentdb-local at buildInfo version 7.0.0 (image ghcr.io/documentdb/documentdb/documentdb-local:latest); it does not prove managed Azure DocumentDB behaviour.
